name: Upstream Improvement PR (human-gated)
description: Turn a verified, REPO-tier fleet-improve candidate into a human-gated draft pull request on the generic repo. Prime clones upstream, applies the change under full repo discipline, self-verifies, opens a DRAFT PR, and hands it to the operator to review and merge. Prime never merges (a template PR is destructive_or_public, B-28).

candidate.description: The verified REPO candidate: problem, evidence (mission IDs), proposed change, module, affected files

module.description: Which improvement module this belongs to (daemons/souls/gateway/skills/dashboard/context/work-layer)

steps.title: Clone the generic repo
steps.description: Run `github-clone` (github-pr skill) to fresh-clone the upstream generic repo (owner/repo from STATE.json) using the Secret-Manager token. Note the returned working dir and default branch. Read-only so far.
steps.accept_criteria: A clean clone exists at the returned dir with origin set to the tokenless GitHub URL.

steps.title: Branch and apply the change
steps.description: In the clone dir, create branch `improve/${module}-<slug>`. Apply ONLY this candidate's change, following full repo discipline: edit + manifest entry in the same commit (C-9), contracts.json if cross-cutting (C-7), and a pure tests/ case where the change is testable. The change MUST be template-clean — no operator/project-specific values (placeholders only). Then run the repo-improvement contamination scan (`fresh-install-scan`) on the changed files; if it flags an operator value, parameterize it or STOP (reclassify to LOCAL). Commit with a version-prefixed message (C-23).
steps.accept_criteria: One branch, one candidate's change committed with version-prefixed message + manifest entries; contamination scan clean on changed files.

steps.title: Self-verify before proposing
steps.description: Inside the clone, run the change's own gates: `node --check` on any edited .mjs, the affected tests/ files, and `corekit/system/validate-contracts` if contracts changed. A change that cannot pass its own gates MUST NOT become a PR — fix it or abandon the candidate. Capture the verification output for the PR body.
steps.accept_criteria: All applicable gates pass in the clone, with the output captured. If any gate fails, the process stops here (no PR).

steps.title: Open a draft PR
steps.description: Write the PR body to a file: Problem, Evidence (the candidate's mission IDs from fleet-retro), the Change, Canon citations, and the self-verify result. Run `github-pr-open --dir <clone> --branch improve/<slug> --title "vYYYY.MM.DD.N.0: <what>" --body-file <body>` (draft by default — do NOT pass --ready). Capture the returned PR URL.
steps.accept_criteria: A draft PR is open on the generic repo; its URL is captured. The PR was NOT marked ready and was NOT merged.

steps.title: Hand to the operator (approval gate)
steps.description: Post the PR URL to the operator with a concise summary: what systemic failure it fixes, the evidence, and the expected effect once merged. This is a proposal for human review — Prime does not merge. On merge, the normal dashboard upgrade rolls it out fleet-wide.
steps.accept_criteria: The operator has received the PR link + summary and owns the merge decision.
